enriched_description: Medium-sized dog with a thick, dense double coat in red, black, blue, cinnamon, or cream. Coat is straight, coarse, and stands off from the body with a pronounced ruff around the neck. Body is compact, square-proportioned, and well-muscled with a level topline. Head is broad with a flat skull and short, broad muzzle. Ears are small, triangular, erect, and set wide apart. Tail is high-set and carried curled over the back. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark with a scowling expression. The breed's signature features include its distinctive blue-black tongue, thick coat, and stilted gait.

Spitz-like dog with a shaggy, greyish double coat consisting of a soft, pale undercoat and longer, harsh outer coat with black-tipped guard hairs. Coat is abundant with a pronounced ruff around the neck and breeches on the hind legs. Body is compact, square-proportioned, and well-balanced. Head is fox-like with a broad skull and moderate muzzle. Ears are small, triangular, erect, and set high. Tail is tightly curled over the back. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark brown with a bright, alert expression. The breed's signature features include its greyish coat with black tipping, spectacles-like markings around the eyes, and tightly curled tail.

Small dog with a short, smooth, glossy coat in red, black, black-and-tan, or belgian mix. Coat is fine, sleek, and lies close to the body. Body is compact, square-proportioned, and sturdy. Head is round with a short, broad muzzle and prominent chin, giving a distinctive expression. Ears are set high, small, and carried semi-erect or pendant. Tail is docked short and carried high. Eyes are large, round, dark, and set wide apart with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its short smooth coat (distinguishing it from the rough-coated Brussels griffon), large round eyes, and distinctive monkey-like face.

Small, straight-legged corgi with a medium-length, dense double coat in red, sable, fawn, or black-and-tan with white markings. Coat is moderate in length with a soft undercoat and harsher outer coat. Body is long, low, and sturdy with a level topline. Head is fox-like with a broad skull and tapered muzzle. Ears are large, erect, pointed, and set wide apart. Tail is naturally short or docked. Eyes are medium-sized, oval, and dark brown with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its short legs, long body, large erect ears, and short tail (distinguishing it from the Cardigan Welsh corgi).

Knitted jacket fastened up the front with buttons or a zipper, typically featuring a V-neck or round neck design. Constructed from wool, cotton, acrylic, or blended yarns with a ribbed texture along the front opening, cuffs, and hem. Available in various lengths from cropped to hip-length. Fabric weight ranges from lightweight for layering to heavy for warmth. Often features patch pockets or welt pockets on the front. The garment's distinctive feature is its open-front design that allows for easy layering over shirts or blouses.

Very small poodle with a dense, curly, single coat in solid colors including white, black, apricot, red, silver, brown, or cream. Coat is harsh-textured, profuse, and stands off from the body. Body is compact, square-proportioned, and well-balanced. Head is slightly rounded with a moderate stop and long, straight muzzle. Ears are set at or slightly below eye level, hanging close to the head. Tail is docked short and carried high. Eyes are medium-sized, oval, and dark with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its tiny size, curly coat, and elegant, refined build.

Small poodle with a dense, curly, single coat in solid colors including white, black, apricot, red, silver, brown, or cream. Coat is harsh-textured, profuse, and stands off from the body. Body is compact, square-proportioned, and well-balanced, larger than the toy but smaller than the standard. Head is slightly rounded with a moderate stop and long, straight muzzle. Ears are set at or slightly below eye level, hanging close to the head. Tail is docked short and carried high. Eyes are medium-sized, oval, and dark with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its small size, curly coat, and elegant, athletic build.

Medium-sized poodle with a dense, curly, single coat in solid colors including white, black, apricot, red, silver, brown, or cream. Coat is harsh-textured, profuse, and stands off from the body. Body is well-proportioned, square, and athletic with a level topline. Head is slightly rounded with a moderate stop and long, straight muzzle. Ears are set at or slightly below eye level, hanging close to the head. Tail is docked short and carried high. Eyes are medium-sized, oval, and dark with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its medium size, curly coat, and elegant, athletic build designed for water retrieving.

Small, nearly hairless dog with smooth, tough skin in various colors including black, grey, slate, red, liver, or spotted. Skin is thick, protective, and may have sparse, coarse hair on the head, tail, and feet. Body is compact, well-proportioned, and slightly longer than tall. Head is broad with a flat skull and tapered muzzle. Ears are large, erect, and set high. Tail is long, thin, and carried low. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its nearly hairless body, warm skin, and ancient Mexican heritage.

Large wolf with a brindled grey coat living in forested northern regions of North America. Coat is thick and dense with a soft undercoat and longer guard hairs, varying from grey to brownish-grey with darker shading along the back. Body is large, muscular, and well-proportioned with a deep chest and powerful legs. Head is broad with a wide forehead and long muzzle. Ears are short, rounded, and erect. Tail is bushy and carried low with a slight upward curve. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and yellow or amber with an intense, alert expression. The breed's signature features include its large size, grey brindled coat, and wolf-like appearance.
